describe: The image shows four separate tall vertical wooden planks on a mid-grey transparent background, side by side with grey gaps between them. Each plank is one of a few large pieces, about 60 pixels wide and running the full height, with dark top and bottom edges. The wood is olive-green to tan with visible grain, and some planks are lighter with orange-brown tints on the left. Lighting is soft and even. Transparent background. Every plank must stay exactly in place.
